## Function Init Project

`morph init --root <dir> --name <name> --language typescript|python|go [--module <path>] [--templates <dir>]`: the template written into an empty directory, the files listed.

Behaviour: initProject(root, args {project, language, module, templates}, cwd) → {code, document}; root is absolute. In order: 1. templates = defaultTemplatesDir() when args.templates is null, else path.resolve(cwd, args.templates); defaultTemplatesDir() (exported) = path.resolve(<the directory of this module's file, from import.meta.url>, "..", "..", "templates"): src/scaffold/ and dist/scaffold/ both sit two levels under the package root. 2. root exists and is not a directory → {code 2, document {error {code 2, kind "RefusalError", message "target is not a directory"}}}; root is a directory holding any entry (a dot entry too) → 2 RefusalError "target directory is not empty (first entry: <the first entry name in code-unit order>)". 3. For folder "common" (COMMON_DIR, exported), then folder <language>: <templates>/<folder> not a directory → 2 RefusalError "template folder not found: <folder>". Nothing is written by a refusal. 4. The files: listTemplateFiles(<templates>/common), then listTemplateFiles(<templates>/<language>), keyed by relative path; a language file replaces the common file of the same path; files = the distinct paths in code-unit order. listTemplateFiles(dir) (exported) = every regular file under dir, recursively, as a "/"-joined path relative to dir, in code-unit order; a symbolic link or other kind is skipped; dir not a directory → []. 5. values {name: project, module: module or project when null, language}; root created with its parents; per file: its parent directories created, the text fillTemplate(the source's UTF-8 text, values) written, the mode set to the source's mode & 0o777. fillTemplate(text, values) (exported, pure) replaces every "{{name}}", "{{module}}" and "{{language}}" in one left-to-right pass (a value holding a placeholder is not replaced again); any other brace text ("{{ name }}", "{{other}}", "${{ x }}", "{{join .Imports}}") stays. 6. {code 0, document {name: project, language, module: the value used, files}}, keys in that order. A failure of the file system under way throws (main: exit 3).

Steps:
- reads: Template Folder
- produces: Init Document

## Component requirements / guardrails

Requirements:
- Strict TypeScript: tsconfig strict, ESM, no `any`; every module compiles with tsc --noEmit.
- One Document Out: Every command prints exactly one JSON document on stdout and nothing else; the human log goes to stderr.
- Deterministic Core: cards and compiler give byte-identical results for the same inputs: no clock, no randomness, no environment reads. acceptance is bound only in its pure parts (Snapshot Targets, Build Attempt Diff): Run Acceptance spawns a shell and its only timer is the child's timeout; env and the timeout are parameters, never process.env (06.10, P3). processor reads the environment only in Read Registry; Assemble Request, Read Response, Stub Answer, Assemble Batch and Read Batch are pure of clock and network; the transport and its sleep are parameters of Send Generation and Send Batch (P4, P11). git spawns only in Run Git, synchronously, with the child's environment given whole as a parameter; it reads no process.env and no clock of its own (P6). cli touches the process only in its entry src/cli.ts: the environment, the working directory, the clock and the output streams reach main() as parameters, and the environment reaches the processor only through Read Registry (P7). language is pure data and pure functions: no clock, no environment, no file system, no child process; node:path is its only Node module; its shell lines are text (P8). contour reads no file, no clock and no environment: it parses the text it is given; the package yaml is imported in Parse Document alone (P9). planner reads no file, no clock and no environment: the cli reads the record and the map and passes which files exist as a function; node:path is its only Node module (P10a). builder reads no file, no clock and no environment: the caller passes the checks, the cards, the profile and the texts of the guard, the locator and the probes; node:path is its only Node module (P10b). primer reads files and spawns git (git's gitOk, the environment a parameter) only in Primer Command, the clock only there through deps.now; Read Runs, Read Story and Render Primer are pure functions of what they are given, no network anywhere (P12a). scout reads no clock, no environment and no network and spawns nothing: Parse Turn, Spend Budget and Seed From Ownership are pure; Cage Path and Run Tool reach the file system only through the ScoutFs parameter (realpath, readFile); elapsed time is a parameter; node:path is its only Node module (P13a). scout-session reaches the model only through the processor's Send Generation and the clock only through deps.now; Run Scout reads the tree through the ScoutFs parameter; Scout Command and Plan From Scout are the scout layer's two node:fs files (git through gitOk and runGit, node:crypto for the sha256 in Scout Command), the environment a parameter (P13b). reviewer's checks (Find Obligations, Check Envelope, Check Guardrails, Plan Mutants, Render Findings) are pure functions of the record, git's outputs and the texts they are given: no file, no clock, no environment, no child process, no Node module (P14a). review-session spawns only through acceptance's Run Acceptance (the mutant runs, each under its timeout) and git's Run Git; Run Mutants writes only through acceptance's Restore Snapshot; Review Command is the reviewer layer's one node:fs file (the record, the map and scout.json read, the review written), the environment a parameter, no clock and no model call (P14b). debt spawns only through acceptance's Run Acceptance and git's Run Git, reads the deck file, the card's files and the run archive through node:fs, no clock and no model call; the environment is a parameter (P17). scaffold reads the template folders and writes the new project through node:fs (node:url only to find the package root from its own module file), spawns nothing, reads no clock and no environment (P18).
- Node Only: Runtime dependencies: Node 20 built-ins and the package `yaml` (the record reader), nothing else; dev dependencies pinned exactly, no ^ or ~.

Guardrails:
- No Network In Tests: tests/setup.ts makes fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket and net.connect throw "network blocked in tests"; only the processor's own transport is mocked.
- No Shell Outside Acceptance: child processes are spawned only by Run Acceptance, the git module (in Run Git alone, P6) and the processor's none; everything else is pure.
- Frozen Tree During Run: while a run is in flight no file outside the cards' targets and .morph/ changes; a changed declared input discards the answer unread.

## Function Parse Command

argv into one Command or a usage error.

Behaviour: parseCommand(argv) scans argv left to right. A token starting with "--" is a flag: --pretty, --judge, --write, --md and --commit take no value; --root, --deck, --processor, --run-id, --deadline, --max-cards, --max-retry-batches, --slice-cap-bytes, --spec, --component, --map, --out, --checks, --batch, --issue, --seed-file, --from-scout, --scout, --mutants, --mutant-timeout, --test, --id, --model, --name, --language, --module, --templates take the next token whatever it is; any other flag (--x=y too) → "unknown flag: <t>"; a value flag last → "flag <t> needs a value"; a flag twice → "flag <t> given twice", but --component repeats, its values in argv order (the first error by argv wins). Other tokens are words, giving the command: none → "no command (commands: deck check, plan, run, submit, collect, primer, scout, review, card, accept, init)"; "run"; "plan" ("plan --from-scout" when --from-scout is given); "submit"; "collect"; "primer"; "scout"; "review" with two words after it (<base> <head>); "card"; "accept"; "init"; "deck" "check"; a first word report → NotYetError "command report is not available yet"; "deck" add|status|reset|clear → NotYetError "command deck <w> is not available yet"; else "unknown command: <words, space-joined>". An extra word → "unexpected argument: <first extra>". Then in order: a flag the command does not take → "flag <f> does not apply to <command>", in argv order (deck check: --root, --pretty, --deck, --slice-cap-bytes; run: --root, --pretty, --deck, --processor, --run-id, --deadline, --max-cards, --max-retry-batches; plan: --root, --pretty, --spec, --component, --map, --judge, --out, --checks; review: --root, --pretty, --spec, --map, --scout, --mutants, --mutant-timeout, --test, --write; submit: --root, --pretty, --deck, --processor; collect: --root, --pretty, --batch; primer: --root, --pretty, --write; scout: --root, --pretty, --processor, --issue, --seed-file, --deadline; plan --from-scout: --root, --pretty, --from-scout, --out; card: --root, --pretty, --deck, --id, --md; accept: --root, --pretty, --deck, --id, --model, --commit; init: --root, --pretty, --name, --language, --module, --templates); card and accept: no --deck → "missing --deck", no --id → "missing --id", an --id not matching ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ → "--id must match ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ (got '<v>')", card done {name, root, pretty, deck, id, md}; accept: no --model → "missing --model", a --model not matching ^[A-Za-z0-9._/:-]+$ → "--model must match ^[A-Za-z0-9._/:-]+$ (got '<v>')", else done {name, root, pretty, deck, id, model, commit}; init: no --name → "missing --name", a --name not matching ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ → "--name must match ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ (got '<v>')", no --language → "missing --language", a --language not typescript, python or go → "--language must be one of typescript, python, go (got '<v>')", a --module not matching ^[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+$ → "--module must match ^[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+$ (got '<v>')", else done {name, root, pretty, project, language, module (null), templates (null)}; review: fewer than two refs → "review needs two refs: <base> <head>", a --scout not matching ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ → "--scout must match ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ (got '<v>')", --mutants then --mutant-timeout not a positive integer, else done {name, root, pretty, base, head, spec, map, scout, mutants (null), mutantTimeoutSeconds (120), test (null), write}; plan --from-scout: a value not matching ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ → "--from-scout must match ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ (got '<v>')", else done {name, root, pretty, fromScout, out: null when not given}; plan without --spec → "missing --spec", else plan is done: the plan Command (components [] and map, out null when not given; checks a key only when given); collect without --batch → "missing --batch", a --batch not matching ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ → "--batch must match ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ (got '<v>')", else collect is done; primer is done: {name, root, pretty, write: --write given}; scout without --processor → "missing --processor", without --issue → "missing --issue", a --deadline not a positive integer → "--deadline must be a positive integer (got '<v>')", else done {name, root, pretty, processor, issue, seedFile: null when not given, deadlineSeconds: 1800 when not given}; no --deck → "missing --deck"; run or submit without --processor → "missing --processor"; submit is then done; a run --run-id not matching ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ → "--run-id must match ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ (got '<v>')"; numbers in the order --slice-cap-bytes (deck check), --deadline, --max-cards, --max-retry-batches (run): digits only, ≥ 1 ("<f> must be a positive integer (got '<v>')"), --max-retry-batches ≥ 0 ("must be a non-negative integer"). A failure is {ok: false, error: {error: {code: 4, kind: "UsageError" | "NotYetError", message}}}. Defaults: root ".", pretty false, sliceCapBytes 500000, runId null, deadlineSeconds 2400, maxCards null (the card count), maxRetryBatches 2.

Callee Parse Command: argv into one Command or a usage error.
Behaviour: parseCommand(argv) scans argv left to right. A token starting with "--" is a flag: --pretty, --judge, --write, --md and --commit take no value; --root, --deck, --processor, --run-id, --deadline, --max-cards, --max-retry-batches, --slice-cap-bytes, --spec, --component, --map, --out, --checks, --batch, --issue, --seed-file, --from-scout, --scout, --mutants, --mutant-timeout, --test, --id, --model, --name, --language, --module, --templates take the next token whatever it is; any other flag (--x=y too) → "unknown flag: <t>"; a value flag last → "flag <t> needs a value"; a flag twice → "flag <t> given twice", but --component repeats, its values in argv order (the first error by argv wins). Other tokens are words, giving the command: none → "no command (commands: deck check, plan, run, submit, collect, primer, scout, review, card, accept, init)"; "run"; "plan" ("plan --from-scout" when --from-scout is given); "submit"; "collect"; "primer"; "scout"; "review" with two words after it (<base> <head>); "card"; "accept"; "init"; "deck" "check"; a first word report → NotYetError "command report is not available yet"; "deck" add|status|reset|clear → NotYetError "command deck <w> is not available yet"; else "unknown command: <words, space-joined>". An extra word → "unexpected argument: <first extra>". Then in order: a flag the command does not take → "flag <f> does not apply to <command>", in argv order (deck check: --root, --pretty, --deck, --slice-cap-bytes; run: --root, --pretty, --deck, --processor, --run-id, --deadline, --max-cards, --max-retry-batches; plan: --root, --pretty, --spec, --component, --map, --judge, --out, --checks; review: --root, --pretty, --spec, --map, --scout, --mutants, --mutant-timeout, --test, --write; submit: --root, --pretty, --deck, --processor; collect: --root, --pretty, --batch; primer: --root, --pretty, --write; scout: --root, --pretty, --processor, --issue, --seed-file, --deadline; plan --from-scout: --root, --pretty, --from-scout, --out; card: --root, --pretty, --deck, --id, --md; accept: --root, --pretty, --deck, --id, --model, --commit; init: --root, --pretty, --name, --language, --module, --templates); card and accept: no --deck → "missing --deck", no --id → "missing --id", an --id not matching ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ → "--id must match ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ (got '<v>')", card done {name, root, pretty, deck, id, md}; Callee Deck Check: `morph deck check`: generations, hazards, slice weights.
Behaviour: deckCheckCommand(root, deckPath, sliceCapBytes): Read Deck File (its failure is the result); weighing = Weigh Slices(deck, root, sliceCapBytes); hazards = Find Hazards(deck), then the weighing's; document {deck: deckPath as given, cards: the count, generations: Layer Generations(deck), errors and warnings: the hazards of each severity counted, hazards, weights: the weighing's}, keys in that order; code 2 when errors > 0, else 0.

Callee Run Command: `morph run`: processor, deck, hazards, run branch, Run Deck, archive; one Run Document.
Behaviour: runCommand(root, args, deps, log?), every check before any git call or spend, in order. 1. readRegistry(deps.env); no config with id args.processor → 4 UsageError "processor <id> is not configured" + (": " + the messages of the faults keyed "MORPH_PROCESSOR_<id>_…", "; "-joined, when any). 2. Read Deck File (its failure is the result); no cards → 2 RefusalError "deck has no cards". 3. Find Hazards errors → 2 RefusalError "deck has <n> hazard error(s): " + each "<kind> <cards ","-joined>[ <path>]", "; "-joined; then cards whose acceptance is null or blank → 2 RefusalError "deck has <n> card(s) with no acceptance: <ids in deck order, ","-joined>". 4. start = deps.now() (its only call here); runId = args.runId or mintRunId(start) (UTC "YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS"). 5. Open Run Branch(root, runId, deps.env); a refusal → 2 RefusalError, its error. 6. Run Deck, input {root, runId, branch, deck, budget {maxCards: args.maxCards or the card count, maxRetryBatches, deadline: start + deadlineSeconds × 1000}}, deps {config, transport: {...(deps.transport or realTransport(config.timeoutMs)), saveBatch: (record) => git's saveBatchRecord(root, record)}, commit: makeCommitHook(root, config.model, deps.env), now: deps.now, env: deps.env, interrupted: deps.interrupted, onVariant: line = variantLine(record), keep {...record, line}, log given → log(line)}. 7. Archive Run(root, {runId, deck, report, answers: the kept records}, deps.env). → {code: 3 when report.fault is set (the partial report archived), else runExitCode(report, archive), document: {runId, branch, base, report, archive}}. variantLine(r) (exported) = "morph run: <r.request.customId> <verdict> stage <stages>[ <lastStage>] finish <finishReason, or none> chars <text length, or none>\n". The checkout stays on the run branch.

Callee Emit Document: One JSON document + newline on stdout; --pretty indents by 2.
Behaviour: renderDocument(doc, pretty) = JSON.stringify(doc, null, 2 when pretty) + "\n". errorDocument(code, kind, message) = {error: {code, kind, message}}, keys in that order.

Callee Classify Error: Exit codes: 0 ok; 1 a card not written; 2 a refusal before spend; 3 a fault under way; 4 a usage error.
Behaviour: classifyThrown(e) → {code: 3, document: errorDocument(3, "RuntimeError", e.message for an Error, else String(e))}. runExitCode(report, archive) → 3 when the archive is not ok; else 1 when any outcome is not "written"; else 0. Kinds: UsageError and NotYetError (4), DeckError and RefusalError (2), RuntimeError (3).
